title: Gold after a broad currency-turbulence day

rule.signal: mean over EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, USD/CHF of |daily log return| / sd of its 60 returns before the day >= 1.5
rule.entry: open of gold's first folded daily candle after the signal day
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long x entry on buys
rule.excess: net R minus the mean net R of the same side and hold after every eligible day of the window

tests.what: buy gold after a turbulence day, hold 5 candles (primary)
trade gold the way of its own move on the turbulence day, hold 5 candles
buy gold after a turbulence day, hold 10 candles
